title: Chess rules operations
description: The rules' public functions, as the scripts call them.

entities.name: Play out a game
entities.description: A game from its UCI moves: every position, the SAN of each move and the result.
entities.result: A Chess.Game; result is 1-0, 0-1 or 1/2-1/2 with its reason (checkmate, stalemate, material, repetition, fifty) when the board ends the game, otherwise *.
failures: An illegal move stops the replay there: the game holds the moves before it.

entities.name: Play one move
entities.description: Adds a UCI move to a game and judges the new position.
entities.result: true, with the move, its SAN and the new position added and the result judged again.
failures: The move is not legal: false, and the game is unchanged.

entities.name: List the legal moves
entities.description: Every legal move in a position.
entities.result: The moves as ints (from, to, promotion, flags), including castling, en passant and promotions; those leaving the king in check are left out.

entities.name: Read a UCI move
entities.description: The legal move a UCI string names in a position.
failures: Not a legal move in the position: -1.

entities.name: Say how a game ended
entities.description: A result and reason in words, with the players' names.
entities.result: For example "Checkmate. Ann wins" or "Draw agreed"; "In play" for *.
